# OMP Strata

> Profile, lifecycle tool and acceptance evidence for running the stock Oh My Pi (OMP) coding agent against
> a stock, local Strata inference server on one Windows 11 + RTX host. It forks neither project and adds no
> proxy: every download is pinned by URL, size and SHA-256; stock `setup.py` runs unmodified from verified
> local inputs; Strata binds to loopback behind an API key; stock OMP runs in an isolated profile with every
> model role on the local server and no cloud fallback. Python standard library only. Qualified and current (2026-11-02):
> stock Strata v0.2.9 (engine 0.1.55) + stock OMP 18.15.0 across all three hosts and the Mac Studio route: on the
> RTX 4090 + RTX 3090 pair in `rtx3090-win-a` (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next IQ3_S at the trained 262,144-token context, stock
> roles `--gpu-roles 0=main,1=helper` putting the RTX 4090 as Main staged last, manual layer split 24 `--layer-split 24`,
> stage dense-weight trim `--trim-stage-weights` (`strata.trim_stage_weights: true`) growing each card's expert cache by
> 1.8 GiB to 19.15 GiB on the RTX 3090 and 17.76 GiB on the RTX 4090 vs 17.35 and 16.01 GiB without trim and keeping
> G17's near-limit task wall at 60.4 s vs 67.0 s on v0.2.8 `roles-pledirect`, pipeline windows 2, no batch slots, display
> on the RTX 4090, and `strata.ple_io: "direct"` pinning stock `--ple-io direct` to keep the 26.8 GiB per-layer embedding
> (PLE) table on direct SSD reads, preserving the engine's 8,192 MiB automatic conversation cache and 27.7 GiB Windows
> commit headroom of a 135.7 GiB limit;
> `win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-pw2-disp4090-roles-split24-trimweights-pledirect-parking-strata0.2.9-omp18.15.0`;
> [ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-pw2-disp4090-roles-split24-trimweights-pledirect-parking-strata0.2.9-omp18.15.0/qualification.json);
> rolling back to `win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-pw2-disp4090-roles-split24-trimweights-pledirect-parking-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0`;
> its v0.2.9 tuning variant
> `win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-pw2-disp4090-roles-split24-trimweights-pledirect-env86g-parking-strata0.2.9-omp18.15.0`,
> pinning the engine's `sm_86` table + `gdn_stack`, passed cold decode at +6.5% at 8K and +11.4% at 100K and every TTFT
> bar in three paired cold starts against the v0.2.9 base, but missed the pre-registered 512/512-token single-request bar at
> 1.039 vs >= 1.05, so by the stop rule no chain ran and it stays an unqualified draft),
> on an RTX PRO 6000 at the trained 262,144-token context with four batch slots, per-slot multi-token prediction (MTP)
> `--batch-mtp` (`strata.batch_mtp: true`), direct PLE reads `--ple-io direct` (`strata.ple_io: "direct"`), KV in VRAM
> `--kv-streaming off` (`setup_args.kv_streaming: "off"`; 78 GiB available-RAM start floor), stock `serve/server.py`'s
> Linux-only nine-switch parallel-slot stack and two-switch GDN tensor-core prompt stack in `strata.engine_env`
> (cold-start A/B against the v0.2.9 base: 1,000-token prompt output +11.3% at 1 request, +29.3% at 2 and +34.8% at 4;
> 4 × 32K +13.1%; single-request TTFT p95 −19.6%; decode flat at 0 to +2.2% at 100K; stock greedy output byte-identical
> in every block; 31.0-31.3 s restart readiness in G16/G20/G21 vs 35.1-39.7 s on the base; G15 kill recall 44.7-45.4 s
> vs 48.7-49.4 s; and 83.35 GiB G10 Windows commit headroom of a 219.70 GiB limit with 129.57 GiB available RAM and
> 74,906 MiB GPU memory vs 81.28 GiB, 112.58 GiB and 59,712 MiB on the base), the engine's 8,192 MiB conversation
> parking and 32K prompt chunks
> (`win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-batchmtp-pledirect-kvvram-envpg-parking-strata0.2.9-omp18.15.0`;
> [ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-batchmtp-pledirect-kvvram-envpg-parking-strata0.2.9-omp18.15.0/qualification.json);
> rolling back to the 2026-11-02 v0.2.9 base profile
> `win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-batchmtp-pledirect-parking-strata0.2.9-omp18.15.0`; the PRO's v0.2.9 `UD-IQ4_XS`
> and `NVFP4-QAD` model candidates stay comparison-only drafts; GDN tensor-core numerics are not bit-exact upstream, and
> engine env pins are reviewed per engine release in `ENGINE_ENV_REVIEWED_ENGINES`, engine 0.1.55 only),
> and on an RTX 5090 (`rtx5090-win-a`), where the tuned 262,144-token Coder IQ1_M profile is the host's default
> (`win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-262k-kvvram-kvgrow-envg-strata0.2.9-omp18.15.0`;
> [ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-262k-kvvram-kvgrow-envg-strata0.2.9-omp18.15.0/qualification.json)),
> pinning `setup_args.kv_streaming: "off"` (`--kv-streaming off`, lowering the setup-derived available-RAM start floor
> from 36 GiB to 34 GiB), `strata.kv_grow: true` (`--kv-grow`) and stock `gdn_stack` in `strata.engine_env` (cold TTFT
> −8.6% at 32K and −8.9% at 100K, 100K decode −2.7% at 0.973 above its 0.97 bar, 512/512-token single-request output +2.5% and
> 32K +8.4%), with a 4,352 MiB automatic conversation cache (23 parks in G19 vs 3,072 MiB on the base; G10 serving:
> 13.35 GiB available RAM and 20.10 GiB commit headroom of an 85.15 GiB limit vs 10.55 / 17.55 GiB; G16/G20/G21 restart
> ready in 18.6-18.9 s, lowest available RAM 8.61 GiB in G17 vs 6.56 GiB on the base), rolling back to the 2026-11-02
> v0.2.9 base profile `win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-262k-strata0.2.9-omp18.15.0` (36 GiB start floor; the unpinned-GDN
> fallback `win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-262k-kvvram-kvgrow-strata0.2.9-omp18.15.0` was prepared and never installed).
> Operating condition for the RTX 5090 262K default: the host's Docker Desktop and WSL, which run its production NInfer
> container, must be stopped; after WSL restarts, that container must be recreated by the owner's pinned relaunch script
> and re-registered with the owner's fleet controller (a WSL-up start was refused at 7.3 GiB available RAM while another
> of the owner's agents held host memory; untested on an idle host). The 131,072-token Coder IQ1_M profile
> (`win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-131k-strata0.2.9-omp18.15.0`;
> [ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-131k-strata0.2.9-omp18.15.0/qualification.json))
> is the qualified alternative for running with Docker Desktop and WSL up (the production container stopped by the fleet
> controller; 34 GiB start floor), rolling back to `win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-131k-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0`. All three
> qualified v0.2.9 RTX 5090 ledgers have 21 pass and 3 not applicable.
> Stock Strata v0.1.40.3 + stock OMP 18.8.4 stays qualified for single-card RTX 3090 hosts
> ([ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-coder-iq1m-131k-strata0.1.40.3-omp18.8.4/qualification.json)).

> single-card RTX 3090 and RTX 4090. Community project; not affiliated with or endorsed by the
> Oh My Pi maintainers, the Strata maintainer, Qwen or NVIDIA.

## Install

- From a checkout, with the current candidate profile: `validate` → `fetch` → `install` → `keygen` →
  `start` → `launch-omp` → `stop` (`py -3 scripts\omp_strata.py <command> --profile <profile> --root <root>`).
- One integration root per candidate; nothing is written to the user's normal OMP configuration or to
  `%APPDATA%\Strata`.

## Boundaries

- Supported: the qualified profiles under `profiles/` (Windows 11, a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000, RTX 5090, RTX 3090
  or RTX 4090, or the RTX 4090 + RTX 3090 layer-split pair; every other profile is a draft or a rollback installation),
  text only, single user, loopback only.
- Remote use: the Mac Studio's current qualified route,
  `client-rtxpro6000-262k-batchmtp-pledirect-kvvram-envpg-strata0.2.9-omp18.15.0`, runs stock OMP 18.15.0 through an
  SSH local forward to `win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-batchmtp-pledirect-kvvram-envpg-parking-strata0.2.9-omp18.15.0`,
  the PRO's current v0.2.9 262K `kvvram-envpg` profile. Its independent G23 passed on 2026-11-02 at `acd7549`: missing
  key refused before launch, wrong key 401, health RTT 5.5-6.3 ms and stream TTFT 0.172 s (vs 0.206 s on the v0.2.9
  base route); tunnel drop failed the turn in flight with the prior transcript preserved, and nonce recall passed after
  tunnel reopen (0.81 s), client restart (0.67 s) and verified server restart (1.40 s). Its qualified rollback,
  `client-rtxpro6000-262k-batchmtp-pledirect-strata0.2.9-omp18.15.0`, reaches the PRO's v0.2.9 262K batch-MTP +
  PLE-direct base rollback (G23 pass on 2026-11-02 at `6fec79d`). The 0.2.8 batch-MTP, 0.2.8 `slots4-parking`, 0.2.7,
  0.2.3, 0.2.1, 0.1.44.1, 0.1.43.1, 0.1.43 and 0.1.42 262K routes and `client-rtxpro6000-strata0.1.41-omp18.8.6` 131K
  route stay earlier history.
- Not supported: images, remote clients other than those qualified current and rollback Mac-to-RTX PRO 6000 routes, other
  operating systems, durable engine state across restarts, multiple tenants. Comparisons with other runtimes are
  separate, comparison-only tools.
- Security: loopback only, API key required on every model, control and metrics route, key in a user-only
  file, ambient provider credentials scrubbed from OMP's environment, no telemetry. Not a sandbox, a
  multi-tenant service or an egress firewall.

## Canonical documents

- [README](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata#readme): status, what the tool does, layout, host-free checks
- [Quickstart](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/QUICKSTART.md): the tested install, start, use and stop commands
- [Operations](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/OPERATIONS.md): lifecycle, recovery, logs, upgrades, requalifying a new tuple
- [Security](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/SECURITY.md): what is and is not isolated, observed egress, known defects
- [Measurements](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/MEASUREMENTS.md): resources, throughput, context, restart cost, evaluation results
- [Decision](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/DECISION.md): integration readiness, usefulness, further investment
- [Baseline](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/BASELINE.md): the frozen component tuple and why it was chosen
- [Upstream](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/UPSTREAM.md): findings reported to Strata and Oh My Pi
- [Release ledgers](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/tree/main/releases): manifest, gate ledger, receipts and scrubbed evidence per profile
